MATCH (impl:Type)-[:IMPLEMENTS]->(iface:Type)
WHERE iface.name IN ['TbDashboardService', 'DashboardService', 'TenantService', 'UserService', 'AccessControlService', 'CustomerService', 'TbResourceService']
MATCH (a:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Package)-[:CONTAINS]->(impl)
RETURN iface.name AS interface, impl.fqn AS implementation,
  split(a.fileName, '/target/')[0] + '/src/main/java/' + replace(impl.fqn, '.', '/') + '.java' AS file
ORDER BY iface.name, impl.name
